newsitem.title: ITALY: Germany's Tietmeyer says econony on upturn.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Tietmeyer says econony on upturn.

text.p: German Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said the German economy is clearly on a new cyclical upturn, but said one should not overestimate figures for second quarter growth.

"Germany is on the wave of a new cyclical upturn but one should not overestimate the (GDP) figure of the second quarter because it is a little artificially high because of the low first quarter," Tietmeyer told reporters at an international conference at this northern Italian lakeside resort.
He said he had to take second and first quarter estimates together due to influences from the construction sector.
"There is clearly an upturn and I hope very much it will last," Tietmeyer said.
